rationale: The stock gapped up ~5.6% on strong Q3 results but has since faded from the $12.27 high to $11.84, sitting below VWAP ($11.87) and in the lower half of today's range (41.2%), suggesting the gap-up enthusiasm has been absorbed by sellers.
